program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((reds (find-color g 2)))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)
        (let ((v (cell-at g r c)))
          (if (and (= v 0)
                   (any?
                     (lambda (rr)
                       (and (not (= rr r))
                            (any?
                              (lambda (cc)
                                (and (not (= cc c))
                                     (= (cell-at g r cc) 2)
                                     (= (cell-at g rr c) 2)
                                     (= (cell-at g rr cc) 2)))
                              (range w))))
                     (range h)))
              3
              v))))))
